name: Are there different types of screen doors for sliding door replacement?

mainEntity.name: Are there different types of screen doors for sliding door replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, beyond just the mesh material, there are different styles of sliding screen doors. Standard sliding screen doors are the most common, designed for basic insect protection and ventilation. You can also find retractable screens that disappear into a cassette when not in use, offering an unobstructed view. Some heavy-duty options are available for increased durability, and custom-built screens can be fabricated for non-standard door sizes or specific aesthetic preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Beyond mesh, options include standard sliding screens, retractable screens for unobscured views, and heavy-duty or custom-built models.
